snippet.title: 🎬 Guess the Heroine's Character Name! 😂🔔 | #shorts #telugushorts
snippet.description:
🎬 GUESS THE HEROINE'S CHARACTER NAME! 😂🔔

Can you guess the heroine's character name from a Telugu movie? 🤔🔥

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:

1️⃣ The host announces a Telugu movie name. 🎥

2️⃣ Two players race to press the bell and guess the heroine's character name! 🔔

3️⃣ Correct Answer = +1 Point ✅
   Wrong Answer = -1 Point ❌

4️⃣ If the first player is wrong, the other player gets a chance to answer!

🏆 First player to reach 5 points WINS!

😂 Funny guesses, tricky questions & unexpected answers!

👇 How many character names can YOU guess? Comment below! ❤️

#MovieChallenge #TeluguMovies #HeroineChallenge #FamilyChallenge #BhaskarAndFamily
